detail.title: INTEX IT-1604 W SMPS & USB Computer Cabinet
detail.overview: The INTEX IT-1604 W Computer Cabinet is designed for users who demand durability, functionality, and modern aesthetics. Built with a heavy-duty metallic steel body, this cabinet offers excellent protection for your PC components while ensuring efficient airflow through dedicated CPU and PCI graphic heat vents. With multiple front USB ports, audio and microphone connectivity, and support for Micro ATX and Mini ATX motherboards, it is the perfect choice for home, office, and gaming setups. Its sleek brushed-finish front panel and compact design make it a stylish addition to any workspace.
